subject: angol
title: Two kinds of holiday
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le az embereket és a helyeket, hasonlítsd össze a két nyaralást, majd válaszolj a vizsgáztató kérdéseire.

scenes.description: A family with two small children is on holiday on a crowded sandy beach by the sea. The father is putting sun cream on the little boy, while the mother is reading a magazine under a big umbrella. Behind them there are rows of sunbeds, a hotel and an ice-cream seller. It is a very hot, sunny day and the sea is full of swimmers.

Two young backpackers, a boy and a girl, are hiking on a mountain path. They are carrying big rucksacks with sleeping bags, and the girl is checking the map on her phone. Behind them you can see high rocky mountains, a lake and a few clouds. They look tired but happy.

prompts: Describe the people and the places.
What are the advantages of each type of holiday?
Which holiday would you prefer? Why?
followUpQuestions: What was your best holiday ever? Why?
Do you prefer relaxing or being active on holiday?
Would you like to go on a hiking trip with friends? Why or why not?
Is it better to travel with your family or with your friends?
How do you prepare for a trip?

usefulPhrases.en: The beach is full of tourists.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The first picture shows a family with two small children on a crowded sandy beach. The father is putting sun cream on the little boy, and the mother is reading a magazine under an umbrella. In the second picture two young backpackers are hiking on a mountain path. They're carrying big rucksacks, and the girl is checking the map on her phone. They look tired but happy. Both pictures show people on a summer holiday, but in very different ways. Each type of holiday has its advantages. A beach holiday is relaxing and comfortable, so it's perfect for families with small children. A hiking trip is cheaper and more adventurous. I'd prefer the second one, because I love nature and I don't like crowded places. Last summer I went hiking in the Mátra Mountains with my friends, and it was great fun.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How do you prepare for a trip?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I usually check the weather forecast and make a list of things to pack. For a hiking trip, I also download the maps to my phone, because there's often no signal in the mountains.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó leírja az embereket és a helyeket, mindkét nyaralástípus előnyeit megnevezi, indoklással választ, saját élményt mesél, és a rákérdezésre is részletesen felel.
Szókincs: az utazás szavai változatosak és pontosak (sun cream, backpackers, rucksacks, adventurous, weather forecast, no signal).
Nyelvhelyesség: a középfokú melléknevek (cheaper, more adventurous) helyesek, a választást az „I'd prefer …” fejezi ki, a múlt nyári túra egyszerű múltban áll.
Érdemes megtanulni: „They look tired but happy.”, „Each type of holiday has its advantages.”, „it's perfect for families with small children”, „there's often no signal in the mountains”.
